system.description: When a hostile creature forces you to make a saving throw to resist a Genjutsu they cast that you are aware of, your Star Chakra lashes out attempting to disrupt the intrusion of chakra. As a reaction, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra, as part of this saving throw. For every 2 Star Chakra spent, you gain a rank of Mastery to that saving throw results.
